title: Car Accident Lawyer: How Can You Navigate a Left-Turn Road Accident Case in Your Favor?
htmlContent: Living in a big city like San Diego requires daily dealing with long commutes and crowded highways. Unfortunately, these traffic conditions don't just consume your time and energy but also create dangerous road accident scenarios. Many people multitask while driving, increasing the risk of car accidents. Suppose you are at the traffic signal and waiting for it to turn green so you can take a left turn. As you start driving, another car from the opposite direction recklessly speeds through the intersection and hits your vehicle. As a consequence, you may lose your income, undergo emotional trauma, and incur medical bills. What would you do in this situation? Your first thought will be to bring that driver to justice and punish them for reckless behavior. Typically, left-turn accidents occur due to driver's negligence. Reasons can be violating traffic lights, speeding, etc. However, you must prove the other person guilty to qualify for fair compensation. You can consult a reputed personal injury lawyer in the city for this. You can visit hhjtrialattorneys.com for help. They can explain the nitty-gritty based on your case and fight for a suitable damage claim. Here are some critical insights regarding this. At-fault party for left-turn accidents The turning driver is typically blamed for this because they are required to yield. However, many factors are considered due to comparative negligence law in California. Even if you took the left turn, you could claim partial compensation depending on the other driver's negligence. If the driver's speeding caused the accident, he can be held responsible even though you didn't yield. Someone indulging in distracted driving can also be blamed. The authorities will also consider weather conditions, visibility, road conditions, unpredictable scenarios, and mechanical failures before deciding on the liability. Ways to fortify your left-turn accident claim An expert lawyer knows that a victim can use the power of negligence per se in California. The doctrine talks about not exercising enough care and harming others. In this type of road accident, anyone violating Vehicle Code 22100 can be held negligent. If your lawyer manages to establish this, you can have an advantage. The other driver’s fault can be easily proved following this legal tool. Due to this, you can obtain reasonable compensation for your pain, suffering, treatment, lost income, and other accident-related damages. What about you not yielding? A seasoned lawyer can use strong defense mechanisms to show you did yield and took a safe left turn. For this, he may need testimonies of the bystanders and passengers who saw the accident. Your dashcam footage can be used as video evidence. Plus, all the parameters of safe turning can be analyzed, such as distance, speed, and timing. Since not yielding can become a sore point in your left-turn collision, your lawyer must study your case closely and weigh all the options well. Otherwise, you can be found to be at fault. If this happens, you may not recover any compensation for the injuries. At the same time, you can be asked to compensate the other driver for damages. More precisely, you can win a left-turn accident case only with a proper understanding of the complexities and your rights as a driver in that specific situation. So, first, hire a good lawyer.
